title: Project discovery and constraints
summary: Convert intent into acceptance criteria, constraints, non-goals and reversible assumptions.

title: Choosing a database
summary: Select a persistence strategy from workload, query needs, concurrency and operations; do not choose by popularity.

title: Dependency selection playbook
summary: Check necessity, version, license, compatibility, vulnerabilities and maintenance with source-backed evidence.

title: Architecture and change impact
summary: Prefer minimal viable architecture, explicit boundaries, compatibility and reversibility.

title: Root-cause debugging
summary: Reproduce, isolate, form hypotheses, verify cause, patch, regress-test; stop repeated unchanged failures.

title: Product interface engineering
summary: Derive user journeys, design tokens, states and accessibility requirements; visually verify when tools allow.

title: Secure development
summary: Threat-model data and trust boundaries, apply secure defaults, verify authorization and evidence.

title: Release and operations
summary: Authorization, reproducible build, release gates, rollout, smoke tests, monitoring and rollback.
